plugin.name: NEKO Sisters: Survivors React
plugin.description: A bullet-heaven survival roguelite bundled inside the plugin: dodge with WASD, weapons fire automatically, collect, upgrade and synthesize, and survive 20 waves. Open the panel and play. Nightmare difficulty hides a secret boss. The catgirl auto-reports your run in the chat.
entries.game_event.name: Game event report
entries.game_event.description: Generates one commentary line through the active game session, then sends it once through that session’s speech pipeline. Rate limited.
entries.speak.name: Make the catgirl say this
entries.speak.description: Speaks the given line through the host's official TTS pipeline (the same B-layer output channel as built-in minigames). Called automatically by the game page (pet/weather lines), without additional throttling.
entries.sync_avatar.name: Sync catgirl avatar
entries.sync_avatar.description: Re-syncs the Live2D engine and the current catgirl model from the local host into the plugin vendor directory. Runs automatically at plugin startup; use this manually if the host was opened later.

content.characters.yui.name: Yui
content.characters.yui.description: Balanced stats with no major weaknesses. Suits any build.
content.characters.mimi.name: Xiaoba
content.characters.mimi.description: Higher damage with a fragile body. Favors aggressive melee builds.
content.characters.luna.name: Roki
content.characters.luna.description: Strong elemental damage and longer range, but very fragile.
content.characters.shiro.name: Developer Cat
content.characters.shiro.description: High health and armour, with lower movement speed and damage.
content.characters.nana.name: Lucky Yui
content.characters.nana.description: Better drops and shop quality, with more materials from harvesting.
content.characters.kuro.name: Kuro
content.characters.kuro.description: Very high critical chance and attack speed, but low health.
content.characters.youyi.name: Lolita Yui
content.characters.youyi.description: Strong healing, recovery and shields with lower damage output.
content.characters.neon_party.name: Neon
content.characters.neon_party.descriptio: Stronger, faster and more numerous turrets, with a fragile and slow owner.
